descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S25 Ask AI fails or returns nothing, both contexts: explicit message, no answer, the typed question kept

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer; what the physician typed is kept; the app retries, then the backup model answers or a clear message shows — never waiting with nothing. (UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Make-session fixture; every ai/assist:askChart call fails (cp1–cp2), then every call returns an empty string (cp3–cp4)

When Type "What is the latest potassium?" (not a preset label) and tap Ask AI on Hospital Pre-Round, NH Encounter, Hospital Encounter and NH Pre-Round

Then Failed call: the 'couldn’t be reached … tap Ask AI again' copy; empty reply: the 'returned no answer' copy; no 'Patient Record' answer block, no lab value, not stuck on 'Searching…', the typed question still in the box

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U9: each checkpoint mustContain 'latest potassium' (question kept) and its failure copy; mustNotContain 'Patient Record', 'Searching', 'WBC', 'mmol', 'mEq'. Same case as EFS S10 / OAT-03 S06: run once, report under all three

Where it ran: dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
